memoryRule: situated exposure accumulates locally; commitment elects a least-seen remote mark as an absence, makes an exposed mark reply, and gives a third mark the counter-decision
interactionRule: pointer, touch, or keyboard visit only arms a witness; Enter, Space, or the witness control commits; Delete lifts latest; R releases bounded attention

encounterRupture: orbit-and-seal, draw-and-release, and traverse-and-departure -> visit-and-commit where the visited mark is not the causal target
temporalRupture: unseen-face archive, strain field, and route detour -> local exposure history elects a remote absence and changes future selection
mediumRupture: Canvas 2D, inline SVG, and Canvas 2D -> deterministic semantic HTML/CSS geometry with actual DOM mark state
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, production readback, and provider revision linkage
